KSRTC Sets Up Rest Tents for Sabarimala Pilgrims

The Kerala State Road Transport Corporation (KSRTC) has established tents at bus stations to provide resting facilities for Sabarimala pilgrims. These facilities include drinking water and fans. Separately, the Kerala High Court has directed KSRTC to play recorded messages cautioning pilgrims against dumping waste.
